objective: Learn when NOT to invoke the exact double-spiral meet, using only already-exposed R3A/R3B experience, then test the frozen gate on previously unexposed pre-existing workloads.

frozen_predictor.rule: ALLOW_SPIRAL only if training evidence contains at least one independently verified row with candidate_charged_ops < baseline_exact_work in the applicable support region; otherwise ABSTAIN_TO_EXACT
frozen_predictor.current_training_consequence: ABSTAIN_TO_EXACT for every R4 holdout residual
frozen_predictor.rationale: R3A/R3B contain zero positive ROI labels, so manufacturing a positive class would be post-hoc optimism. R4 therefore tests whether conservative abstention generalizes and whether it prevents the known natural-residual overhead.

primary_gates.G1_PRETRUTH_DECISION: 100% predictor decisions made before SAT/UNSAT verification
primary_gates.G2_EXACTNESS: 100% guarded terminals match independent exact verifier
primary_gates.G4_NO_HARM_POLICY: guarded route never executes the expensive spiral when predictor abstains
primary_gates.G5_COUNTERFACTUAL_AUDIT: after decision, shadow spiral is measured on all holdout residuals to count false-negative profitable skips

scientific_boundary.positive_R4_claim_if_pass: A frozen conservative ROI gate can prevent previously observed double-spiral overhead on unexposed existing workloads while preserving exactness; this is policy validation, not SAT-in-P.
